name: Francisco Aleuy Young
title: Product Owner · QA & Systems Analyst
summary: Product Owner and systems/QA professional with 16 years in enterprise systems across telecom and banking, including 4 years owning the backlog for internal service tools at Entel, one of Chile's largest telecoms.

Sits between business stakeholders and developers: turns business requests into Jira user stories with acceptance criteria, runs backlog refinement, coordinates UAT with business users, traces defects to closure and takes releases to production.

Hands-on with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Salesforce, SmartBackOffice, Nokia BSCS, Jira and SQL. Uses AI daily to refine stories, analyze requirements and run test sessions. Bilingual (Spanish native, English professional working proficiency).

experience.title: Product Owner (volunteer)
bullets: Operations digitization for a field-service business: parts inventory app (MVP) and the design of a digital technician report and approval flow.
Mapped the job flow from dispatch to invoice across six tools and a WhatsApp group, ranked 7 pain points by impact on cash collection, and turned the first into the MVP backlog.
Delivered MVP v0.1 (403-part catalogue, stock by warehouse and truck, low-stock alerts, CSV export), built with AI-assisted development; paused by the owner in Nov 2026.

experience.title: Board Director & Product Owner (volunteer)
bullets: Owned Content Loop, an internal content intake and publishing tool for an arts council with 18 member groups.
Ran discovery, wrote requirements, prioritized 3 validated pain points, built and tested the portal, trained a non-technical administrator and handed it off; runs at zero cost on free tiers.
Chose assisted publishing over a direct social-media API integration so the tool keeps working without technical maintenance after handoff.

experience.title: Co-founder, Product Owner & QA Lead
experience.company: Craft beer discovery web platform (startup, pre-launch)
bullets: Web platform to discover craft beers, bars and breweries on an interactive map; product and quality owner alongside two developer co-founders.
Planned and ran two risk-based test cycles: 144 test cases, 24 defects reported (1 high, 10 medium, 13 low), re-tested to closure in ISTQB-style reports.
Set up end-to-end automation with Playwright and AI agents; selected 281 scenarios for automation.

experience.title: Product Owner, Enterprise Systems & Contact Centre
bullets: Owned the backlog (epics to user stories in Jira with acceptance criteria) for internal service tools, running refinement, sprint planning and prioritization for two Scrum teams in Chile and Peru.

Led end-to-end rollout of an HR service management model on the SmartBackOffice workflow platform, integrated with a ticketing tool (IRIS), a conversational bot (Botmaker) and a training platform (Salesia); UAT with business users and a three-week parallel run until 100% migrated.
Defined an RPA to extract purchase-order and ticket data from Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service for a logistics partner, choosing RPA over a slower API integration.
Tested REST APIs in Postman for a contact-centre automation; coordinated defects with developers and vendors to closure and confirmed release outcomes in production with SQL and Power BI.
Used AI to organize and refine user stories and acceptance criteria.

experience.title: Application Support Specialist
bullets: Reproduced and diagnosed production incidents reported by corporate client users, traced root causes with SQL, documented each case and kept users informed until closure.

experience.title: Application Development Analyst
bullets: Configured, loaded and validated new plan and bundle offers in Salesforce for a telecom client (Entel); analysed billing incidents in production and verified fixes with development.

Supported investment agents at a banking client (Security Inversiones): turned requests into PHP (Laravel) and .NET application changes, wrote SQL stored procedures, validated backend data and ran production deployments.
Tracked defects in Jira and validated releases before production.

experience.title: Enterprise Systems Specialist (Entel account)
bullets: Billing Configuration Specialist (2013–2018): configured plans, tariffs and charging rules in Nokia BSCS; prepared test usage files and reconciled billing outputs before every cycle; investigated discrepancies to root cause with SQL, Unix shell and AWK, and ran regression tests with Selenium IDE.
Provisioning Analyst (2010–2013): validated service provisioning flows between commercial systems and the network, isolating failures at the integration point.
Device Testing Technician (2009–2010): executed functional certification and compatibility testing of mobile devices before commercial launch.

experience.title: Guest Services Associate
bullets: Bilingual front-line guest service in a high-volume resort on rotating shifts (evenings and weekends), after relocating to Canada. Included for timeline completeness; usually omitted for senior systems roles.
